name: Button icon
summary: Square button with only an icon, for compact actions like close, edit or more options. Has no Link hierarchy.
use: In toolbars, table rows and headers where space is tight.
For actions with a well-known icon: close, search, menu, edit.
avoid: Actions where the icon is not clear. Use Button with a label instead.
The main action of a page.
anatomy: Icon: via Icon (instance swap). The color follows the hierarchy.
reactProps: Required. Describes the action, not the icon.
behaviour: Same as Button. When Loading, the spinner replaces the icon.
a11y: aria-label is required in code. Without it a screen reader does not know what the button does.
Show the same label in a Tooltip for mouse users.
Target size at least 24×24 px (WCAG 2.5.8). Size=sm meets this; smaller does not.
content: aria-label describes the action: "Close", "Edit project", not "Cross".
do: Combine with a Tooltip with the same text as the aria-label.
Use Tertiary in rows that repeat a lot, so the page stays calm.
dont: An icon button without an aria-label.
Two icon buttons with the same icon but a different meaning on one screen.
tokens: colors are the same as Button
